title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
This job will design and implement advanced data science models to support business needs. You will work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves driving best practices in data science, ensuring data quality, and mentoring junior scientists.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage data science projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals.
* Develop and maintain data models, algorithms, and reporting systems to support data analysis and decision-making.
* Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive strategic initiatives.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and provide actionable insights.
* Ensure data quality and integrity through regular audits and validation processes.
* Mentor and guide junior data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 8 years of professional experience, or a master’s degree with at least six years of experience.
* Strong data science and analytical skills, with the ability to structure and execute complex analyses and build business cases that evaluate benefits, costs, risks, and trade-offs.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with hands-on experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Proficiency in Excel, statistical techniques, data visualization, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to use AI and advanced analytics to build reusable solutions for portfolio measurement, A/B testing, strategy optimisation, and performance analysis.
* Must have experience in end-to-end product experimentation, Product Analytics, Casual Inference, Python/SQL.
* Experience applying Machine Learning techniques to support product/business decision-making.
* Strong understanding of experimental design, test-and-learn methodologies, and performance measurement.
* Demonstrated ability to translate analytical findings into practical business strategies and implementation requirements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex findings succinctly to senior management.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to align stakeholders across Product, GTM, Engineering, and other Data Science teams.
* Proactive and adaptable, with the ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities simulataneously.
* Ability to work independently, identify and resolve issues, and recommend improvements to strategies, and processes.

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

title: Data Scientist (ML)
description:
**PhonePe is seeking a highly analytical and driven Data Scientist to join our team. This role requires a minimum of one year of professional experience and a robust foundation in scalable machine learning implementations.**
**The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in designing and deploying sophisticated models and reusable ML frameworks that improve productivity and help drive strategic business initiatives.**
**Job Description**
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytically-minded Data Scientist to join our growing data science team in Pune, India. In this role, you will leverage advanced statistical techniques and machine learning methodologies to extract actionable insights from complex datasets, driving data-informed decision-making across the organization. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to develop, implement, and optimize predictive models that solve real-world business challenges.
  
  

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models to address business problems and improve organizational performance
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in large and complex datasets
* Clean, preprocess, and transform raw data into structured formats suitable for analysis and modeling
* Build and validate statistical models using appropriate algorithms and evaluation metrics
* Create clear and compelling data visualizations to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders
* Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business analysts to understand requirements and deliver solutions
* Document methodologies, code, and results to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing
* Stay current with emerging data science techniques, tools, and best practices in the field
* Perform model monitoring and maintenance to ensure continued accuracy and performance in production environments
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving data science practices within the team

**Qualifications**
\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*
  
  

* 3-5 years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or related analytics roles
* Strong proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and model development
* Solid understanding of statistical methods, probability theory, and hypothesis testing
* Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms (supervised and unsupervised learning)
* Proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating databases
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Matplotlib
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and handle data preprocessing challenges
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences

\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*
  
  

* Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch
* Familiarity with big data technologies including Apache Spark or Hadoop
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
* Knowledge of A/B testing, experimental design, and causal inference
* Experience with version control systems and collaborative development practices
* Domain expertise in finance, healthcare, e-commerce, or other relevant industries
* Familiarity with model deployment and MLOps practices

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**About Position:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Scientist specializing in LLM Fine-Tuning and Clinical AI to build, optimize, and evaluate enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LoRA/PEFT, and Large Language Models (LLMs). You will play a key role in developing healthcare-focused AI solutions by fine-tuning foundation models, implementing robust evaluation frameworks, and ensuring clinically accurate, safe, and reliable AI-generated outcomes.

* **Role: Senior Data Scientist - LLM Fine-Tuning & Clinical AI**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 6 to 10 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

* Design, develop, and optimize Machine Learning and Deep Learning solutions using Python and PyTorch.
* Train, fine-tune, and evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) for healthcare and enterprise AI use cases.
* Utilize Hugging Face libraries and transformer architectures for model development and deployment.
* Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and PEFT.
* Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and LLM-powered applications.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis on structured and unstructured clinical datasets.
* Develop data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model validation pipelines.
* Design evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy, safety, explainability, and clinical relevance.
* Perform model benchmarking, experimentation, and performance analysis.
* Track experiments and manage model lifecycle using MLflow or Weights & Biases.
* Collaborate with ML Engineers and domain experts to deploy AI models into production.
* Monitor model performance and continuously improve model quality.
* Develop scalable AI workflows and support distributed model training environments.
* Contribute to AI engineering best practices, coding standards, and reusable frameworks.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Stay updated with emerging trends in Machine Learning, Generative AI, NLP, and LLM technologies.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or related domains.
* Strong proficiency in Python programming and software engineering best practices.
* Hands-on experience with PyTorch and modern Deep Learning frameworks.
* Strong expertise in Hugging Face transformers and model ecosystems.
* Experience training, evaluating, and optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Practical experience implementing LoRA, PEFT, and other parameter-efficient fine-tuning approaches.
* Strong understanding of NLP concepts, transformer architectures, and language model workflows.
* Experience developing model evaluation frameworks and benchmarking methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with MLflow or Weights & Biases for experiment tracking and model management.
* Experience working with large-scale datasets and distributed training environments.
* Knowledge of model optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and performance engineering.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working in Agile and cross-functional engineering teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to translate business and clinical requirements into scalable AI solutions.

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Job Requirements**
At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As a Data Scientist on our P&DI data products, you'll turn raw, messy data into models and dashboards that drive real business calls. You will:
  
  

* Dig into large datasets to surface trends, patterns, anomalies, and insights that matter to the business.
* Prepare, validate, and shape datasets — data quality checks and feature engineering included — for every analytical and modelling use case.
* Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to build models for prediction, forecasting, and segmentation.
* Write and run SQL across data platforms to extract, transform, validate, and prep data for analysis.
* Build and maintain dashboards that track key metrics and put insights directly in front of stakeholders.
* Evaluate model performance and turn analytical findings into recommendations the business can act on.
* Use AI tools to work faster — sharper analysis, faster coding, leaner reporting.

**What You Bring**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, or another quantitative field.
* 3–5 years in data science, analytics, market research, or a related field.
* A strong grip on statistical concepts and how to apply them in practice.
* Machine learning fluency — the judgment to select, apply, validate, and evaluate the right technique (regression, classification, tree-based models) in Python and scikit-learn, based on the business question and the data at hand.
* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Databricks or similar data platforms.
* Working knowledge of building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI or similar BI tools.
* An understanding of primary and secondary research methodologies.
* Real, practical experience using AI assistants like Claude or Copilot for coding, analysis, and problem-solving.
* Sharp problem-solving instincts, close attention to detail, and a structured approach to analysis.
* The ability to translate analytical findings into insight that lands with both technical and non-technical audiences.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
